# Website Information

This website utilises [Google Analytics](https://www.google.co.uk/analytics) using [IP anonymisation](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/2763052?hl=en) to understand user engagement while masking your IP address. If you would prefer not to be tracked in this manner, please enable the _Do Not Track_ setting in your web browser.

Your web browser's _Do Not Track_ setting is currently _Off_.

## About flow.je

[flow.je](https://flow.je/) is an aggregator and organiser of data relating to Jersey, Channel Islands.

[flow.je](https://flow.je/) is not affiliated with any company, political party, government or any other third-party organisation, group or individual.
